arms.channel_set: every channel EXCEPT dist_visible_fault / visible_fault_dens_5k / visible_fault_dens_20k

reading: Adding any one of the three visible-fault channels collapses the training loss toward zero and flattens the field: the number of distinct predicted values falls from 160,422 (no_cat) to as few as 38,121 (no_cat_plus_dist). The channels are degenerate on the training presence set - they are computed FROM the catalogue pixels that form it - so the model separates the training data and then scores at chance on withheld segments.
decision: All three excluded from every model in this repository and from the released candidate. Recorded in scripts/build_candidate.py (LEAKY).
